name: input-group
title: Input Group 输入组
description: 给输入框或多行文本框加上图标、文字、按钮等前后缀内容。

whenToUse: 输入框带前后缀图标、单位、按钮或快捷键提示，如搜索框、复制链接
多行文本框带底部操作栏（InputGroup.Textarea）

whenNotToUse.case: 没有附加内容的普通输入

accessibility: InputGroup.Addon 在 DOM 中放在 Input／Textarea 之后，用 align 调整视觉位置，保证焦点顺序
只有图标的 InputGroup.Button 要加 aria-label
仍需用 Field 提供可见标签
responsive: 整组占满容器宽度，附加内容过多会在窄屏挤压输入区
align=block-start／block-end 把附加内容放到输入区上方或下方

files.content:
# Input Group 设计规范

- 输入框前后需要图标、文字、按钮或快捷键提示时，用 `InputGroup.Root` 组合，不要用绝对定位把元素压在 Input 上。
- 框内的输入控件必须用 `InputGroup.Input` 或 `InputGroup.Textarea`，不要放普通 Input；组合的边框、焦点环和错误状态都按这两个控件计算。
- 输入控件同样需要标签：设 `id` 并用 `Field.Label for={id}` 关联，或提供 `aria-label`；搜索框也不例外（检查规则 `valar/input-label`）。
- 附加内容放进 `InputGroup.Addon`，用 `align`（`inline-start`、`inline-end`、`block-start`、`block-end`）定位；纯文字用 `InputGroup.Text`。
- 框内按钮用 `InputGroup.Button`，尺寸只用它的 `size`（`xs`、`sm`、`icon-xs`、`icon-sm`）；只有图标的按钮要有 `aria-label`（检查规则 `valar/button-size-via-prop`、`valar/icon-button-label`）。
- 错误状态设在输入控件上（`aria-invalid="true"`），整个组合会显示错误边框。
- `InputGroup.Button` 的 `outline`、`ghost` 样式文字用正常文字色，不会继承附加区的弱化色；不要为了“更淡”再给它加弱化色的 class，否则像不可点击。
- 框内只有输入控件本身被禁用时整组才会变淡；发送按钮等其他按钮禁用（如消息为空）不会让整组变淡。
- 框内图标按钮默认是圆形，需要胶囊用 `shape="pill"`；文字按钮保持默认圆角。上下两侧有附加栏（`block-start`、`block-end`）的多行输入框（如提示词输入框）会自动加大外框圆角，栏内按钮成为圆形或胶囊，与外框保持同心；不要自己用 class 改外框或按钮圆角。

<script lang="ts" module>
	import { tv, type VariantProps } from "tailwind-variants";

	const inputGroupButtonVariants = tv({
		base: "gap-2 text-sm flex items-center shadow-none",
		variants: {
			size: {
				xs: "h-6 gap-1 rounded-[calc(var(--radius)_-_3px)] px-1.5 [&>svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-3.5",
				sm: "",
				"icon-xs": "size-6 rounded-[calc(var(--radius)_-_3px)] p-0 has-[>svg]:p-0",
				"icon-sm": "size-8 p-0 has-[>svg]:p-0",
			},
			shape: {
				auto: "",
				pill: "rounded-full",
				square: "",
			},
		},
		compoundVariants: [
			// Icon-only buttons are circles, like Button.
			{
				size: ["icon-xs", "icon-sm"],
				shape: "auto",
				class: "rounded-full",
			},
		],
		defaultVariants: {
			size: "xs",
			shape: "auto",
		},
	});

	export type InputGroupButtonSize = VariantProps<typeof inputGroupButtonVariants>["size"];
	export type InputGroupButtonShape = VariantProps<typeof inputGroupButtonVariants>["shape"];
</script>

<script lang="ts">
	import { Button } from "$UI$/button/index.js";
	import { cn } from "$UTILS$.js";
	import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		class: className,
		children,
		type = "button",
		variant = "ghost",
		size = "xs",
		shape = "auto",
		...restProps
	}: Omit<ComponentProps<typeof Button>, "href" | "size" | "shape"> & {
		size?: InputGroupButtonSize;
		shape?: InputGroupButtonShape;
	} = $props();
</script>

<Button
	bind:ref
	{type}
	data-size={size}
	{variant}
	class={cn(
		inputGroupButtonVariants({ size, shape }),
		// The addon around the button is muted text, which outline and ghost buttons would
		// inherit. Buttons must read as clickable, so they take the normal text colour.
		(variant === "outline" || variant === "ghost") && "text-foreground",
		className
	)}
	{...restProps}
>
	{@render children?.()}
</Button>

<script lang="ts">
	import { Input } from "$UI$/input/index.js";
	import { cn } from "$UTILS$.js";
	import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		value = $bindable(),
		class: className,
		...props
	}: ComponentProps<typeof Input> = $props();
</script>

<Input
	bind:ref
	data-slot="input-group-control"
	class={cn("rounded-none border-0 bg-transparent shadow-none ring-0 focus-visible:ring-0 disabled:bg-transparent aria-invalid:ring-0 dark:bg-transparent dark:disabled:bg-transparent flex-1", className)}
	bind:value
	{...props}
/>
{@render children?.()}

<script lang="ts">
	import { Textarea } from "$UI$/textarea/index.js";
	import { cn } from "$UTILS$.js";
	import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		value = $bindable(),
		class: className,
		...props
	}: ComponentProps<typeof Textarea> = $props();
</script>

<Textarea
	bind:ref
	data-slot="input-group-control"
	class={cn("rounded-none border-0 bg-transparent py-2 shadow-none ring-0 focus-visible:ring-0 disabled:bg-transparent aria-invalid:ring-0 dark:bg-transparent dark:disabled:bg-transparent flex-1 resize-none", className)}
	bind:value
	{...props}
/>
